title: Checkout fails with a 502 on card payments
description: Since the 09:00 deploy, card payments at checkout return a 502. PayPal still works.
internal_notes: Customer is Acme Corp, on a 2M EUR contract renewal this month. Do not mention the outage to other accounts.

title: Password reset email never arrives
description: Users on outlook.com addresses do not receive the reset email. Spam folder checked.
internal_notes: Our SPF record still lists the old mail provider. Fix pending in infra ticket OPS-77.

title: Export to CSV drops accented characters
description: Names like 'Nicolò' come out as 'Nicol?' in the CSV export from the reports page.
internal_notes: Probably the Latin-1 encoder in the legacy export service. Owner left the company.

title: Dashboard loads slowly on Monday mornings
description: The main dashboard takes 20+ seconds between 08:00 and 10:00 every Monday.
internal_notes: Weekly report job runs on the same database replica. Customer threatened to churn.

title: Typo in the invoice footer
description: The invoice footer says 'Registred office' instead of 'Registered office'.
internal_notes: Legal asked to also update the VAT number at the same time.

title: Mobile app crashes when uploading a photo
description: On Android 15, attaching a photo larger than 10 MB to a ticket crashes the app.
internal_notes: Crashlytics shows an out-of-memory error in the image resizer. Known since 3.2.

title: SSO login loops back to the sign-in page
description: After the identity provider update, SSO users were redirected to sign-in in a loop.
internal_notes: Root cause: clock skew on one auth node. Postmortem draft in the wiki, not public.

title: Add a dark mode to the customer portal
description: Several customers asked for a dark theme in the customer portal.
internal_notes: Product said no before Q1. Keep it open to track demand.
